name: ogre
description: an Ogre, a huge hunched brute with olive-green skin, red war-paint stripes on his face, arms and belly, a black topknot, small fierce eyes and jutting lower tusks, a necklace of bone fangs, a shaggy brown fur mantle with a bleached bone skull pauldron on his left shoulder, a brown belt hung with bone fangs over a red loincloth, brown fur bracers and fur leg wraps, bare green feet, and a huge wooden club studded with steel spikes in his RIGHT hand, a few tiny orange embers drifting off the club head
hands: the spiked club stays in his right hand on the screen-left side and his left hand is an empty fist on the screen-right side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the club is lifted up over the head with the spiked head pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the club cocked behind the head with the spiked head hanging down behind the shoulders, left fist tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-left, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the club is level, its spiked head pointing to the lower-left
strike.4: contact: club arm fully extended toward the lower-left, the spiked club head smashing down-left, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, left arm swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the club carries on down until its spiked head nearly touches the ground at the lower-left, torso twisted, topknot trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the club lifts back toward the ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-left; head snaps back toward the upper-right, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (left fist flung out to the right, club arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the club dipping, left arm still out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, club arm flung up, left arm drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the club lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the club's spiked head resting on the ground, left arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-right, the club slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-left and head toward the upper-right; the club lies on the ground at the lower-left; the fur mantle spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the fur mantle settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the spiked club on the ground beside him
